ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: This pathway for the intracellular synthesis of Cytidine 5'triphosphate (CTP) begins with the condensation reaction of two small molecules catalyzed by the enzyme aspartate transcarbamylase (ATCASE). This pathway can be described as ______.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows the regulatory pathway of CTP biosynthesis; the starting substances are carbamyl phosphate and aspartic acid, which generate N-carbamyl aspartic acid under the catalysis of Aspartate transcarbamylase (ATCase), and then sequentially pass through L-dihydroorotic acid, orotic acid, orotidine 5'-phosphate, UMP, UTP, and finally generate Cytidine 5'-triphosphate (CTP). The left side of the figure is labeled “High CTP”, and there is a regulatory line returning to the ATCase starting step, with an inhibition symbol at the end. Then reason: When the concentration of the final product CTP is high, it in turn inhibits ATCase early in this pathway, thereby reducing its own continued synthesis; this regulatory method in which the product inhibits a preceding enzymatic step is called feedback inhibition, that is, feedback inhibition.

raw_record.question_text: This pathway for the intracellular synthesis of Cytidine 5'triphosphate (CTP) begins with the condensation reaction of two small molecules catalyzed by the enzyme aspartate transcarbamylase (ATCASE). This pathway can be described as ______.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it shows CTP biosynthesis beginning with carbamyl phosphate plus aspartic acid catalyzed by ATCase, proceeding through orotic acid, OMP, UMP, UTP, and ending at CTP. The diagram also shows “High CTP” feeding back to the ATCase step with an inhibition symbol. Then infer that the product CTP suppresses an earlier enzyme in its own synthesis pathway. Fill the blank with “feedback inhibition.”
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中显示 CTP 生物合成调控途径，起始物是 carbamyl phosphate 和 aspartic acid，在 Aspartate transcarbamylase（ATCase）催化下生成 N-carbamyl aspartic acid，随后依次经过 L-dihydroorotic acid、orotic acid、orotidine 5'-phosphate、UMP、UTP，最终生成 Cytidine 5'-triphosphate（CTP）。图左侧标注 “High CTP”，并有一条回到 ATCase 起始步骤的调控线，末端是抑制符号。再推理：最终产物 CTP 浓度高时反过来抑制该途径早期的 ATCase，从而减少自身继续合成；这种产物抑制前面酶促步骤的调控方式称为 feedback inhibition，即反馈抑制。
